title: Imprint
euBody: European Commission platform for online dispute resolution: https://ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr/. Our email address is listed above.

sections.body: The controller under the GDPR is {company}, {street}, {city}, {region} {postal}, {country}. You can reach us by email at {email}.

When accessing this website the following data are processed for technical reasons: IP address (anonymized), date and time of the request, browser and operating system used, page requested. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in secure and stable operation). Data are deleted after 30 days.

When you fill out the contact form or contact us by email or WhatsApp, we process your information to handle your inquiry and any follow-up. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (pre-contractual measures).

For customers we conclude a data processing agreement per Art. 28 GDPR before contract signature. All customer data are processed exclusively in data centers in Frankfurt am Main (ISO 27001, DIN EN 50600).
You have the right at any time to:
list: Access to the personal data concerning you (Art. 15 GDPR)
Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR)

sections.body: This website does not set marketing or tracking cookies. Only technically necessary cookies required for operation are used. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
